task.title: Dual-issuer cutover from Entra ID v1.0 to v2.0
task.shortdesc: To migrate from Microsoft Entra ID v1.0 to v2.0 without interrupting clients in Red Hat Quay, you can set the v2.0 discovery endpoint and temporarily list both issuers in OIDC_ISSUERS.

step.cmd: Set OIDC_SERVER to the v2.0 endpoint (https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0/).
Add both issuer URLs to OIDC_ISSUERS:
Update upstream clients to v2.0 tokens.
After all clients use v2.0, remove the v1.0 issuer from OIDC_ISSUERS.
